question: How much can I safely save a month?
title: Room to save

cells.title: Room to save in a usual month, and the buffer
cells.code:
s = kori.safe_to_save()
b = s["buffer"]
cap, already, extra = s["monthly_capacity"], s["already_saving_monthly"], s["extra_monthly"]
emit("monthly_capacity", round(cap, 2), "eur_per_month", "Room to save in a usual month")
emit("already_saving", round(already, 2), "eur_per_month", "Already saving a month")
emit("could_add", round(extra, 2), "eur_per_month", "Could add a month")
emit("now", round(s["now"], 2), "eur", "Safe to save right now")
emit("covered", b["months_covered"], "months", "Months of musts your balance covers")
emit("target_months", b["target_months"], "months", "Months to aim for")
emit("rest", max(0.0, round(b["target_months"] - b["months_covered"], 1)), "months", "Months still to cover")
emit("gap", round(b["gap"], 2), "eur", "About your buffer")

if not s.get("partial_view"):
    if cap > 0:
        say(f"In a usual month you can safely save about **{eur(cap)}**." + (f" You already save {eur(already)}, so you could add {eur(extra)}." if already > 0 else ""))
    elif already > 0:
        say(f"You already save **{eur(already)} a month**, and a usual month leaves no room for more right now.")
    else:
        say(f"A usual month leaves **no room to save** right now: what comes in goes out.")
